description: Asks which array-valued functions the expression service admits and what an array-typed result does at the DAO boundary: Array, Split, Join, Filter, UBound and LBound over them, indexing the result in place, IsArray/VarType/TypeName of an array, the financial functions that take an array (IRR, NPV, MIRR), and CVar of an array. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Worker died with an access violation (0xC0000005) inside Database.OpenRecordset of "SELECT Array() FROM One" (lifecycle trace, program op 115). Execution stays Uncertain; the earlier calls of the probe are not captured because the process died.
